quests.trigger: An unaccompanied minor requests rations at a ruin crossing.
quests.discovery: A child sits against the concrete. Their caloric math is visibly failing. 'Do you have any food?' The request is made without inflection.

choices.label: Give all your food
choices.outcome_text: You hand over the rations. The child consumes half and pockets the rest. They hand you a charcoal drawing in exchange. A transaction.
choices.epitaph: Transferred all rations to the minor. Received charcoal schematic in return.

choices.label: Give half your food
choices.outcome_text: The child eats carefully, tracking your hands. Survival arithmetic.
choices.epitaph: Allocated half rations to the minor. A calculated expenditure.

choices.label: Give a little food
choices.outcome_text: A crust changes hands. It delays starvation by three hours.
choices.epitaph: Provided a crust. It shifted the math, but didn't solve it.

choices.label: Refuse and walk on
choices.outcome_text: You shake your head. The child goes back to conserving energy.
choices.epitaph: Refused the minor's requisition. Conserved my own supply.

quests.trigger: A family of four is found sheltering in an abandoned apartment block.
quests.discovery: Two adults, two children. The mother holds an infant that hasn't made a sound. 'We have not eaten in a week,' the father states, delivering a status report.

choices.label: Give all your supplies
choices.outcome_text: You empty your pack. The father logs the intake without speaking. The family marks you as an allied asset.
choices.epitaph: Transferred all stores to the family unit. They registered the alliance.

choices.label: Give half your supplies
choices.outcome_text: Half your stores stay behind. They divide the calories immediately. An organized protocol.
choices.epitaph: Allocated half stores. Enough to extend their operational window.

choices.label: Give a little
choices.outcome_text: You leave a few tins at the door. The mother logs the receipt. The father continues calculating.
choices.epitaph: Left minor provisions. A marginal extension of their timetable.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome_text: You decline the requisition. The mother nods, updating her probability matrix. The father swears.
choices.epitaph: Refused the family's requisition. Maintained personal operational capacity.

quests.trigger: A man with a compound fracture lies in an alley.
quests.discovery: A man lies bleeding in the alley, his femur visibly compromised. 'Help me,' he requests, measuring his blood loss against the arrival of scavengers.

choices.label: Give medical supplies
choices.outcome_text: You apply the splint and bandages. He logs the medical debt and assures repayment.
choices.epitaph: Applied field trauma kit. The subject registered the medical debt.

choices.label: Give food instead
choices.outcome_text: No bandages. You leave calories. The food stabilizes his shock, but the bone remains un-set.
choices.epitaph: Provided calories instead of medical aid. The fracture remains a liability.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You bypass the hazard. He recalculates his survival odds and goes quiet.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed the injured man. Conserved medical supplies.

choices.label: Take his supplies
choices.outcome_text: You requisition his pack. His mobility is compromised; he cannot contest the transfer.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned the injured man's supplies. An uncontested transfer.

quests.trigger: A severely dehydrated traveler enters your camp perimeter.
quests.discovery: The traveler stops at the perimeter line, exhibiting severe desiccation. 'Water,' they request, prioritizing hydration over security protocols.

choices.label: Give all your water
choices.outcome_text: You transfer the canteen. They consume the contents and dictate the coordinates of a clean spring.
choices.epitaph: Transferred water rations. Received coordinates for a clean spring.

choices.label: Give half your water
choices.outcome_text: You allocate half the canteen. They meter their intake carefully.
choices.epitaph: Allocated half water rations. Kept the subject functional.

choices.label: Give a sip
choices.outcome_text: A minimal transfer. They assess the volume and process the transaction.
choices.epitaph: Provided minimal hydration. A negligible operational impact.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome_text: You secure the canteen. They register the refusal and resume their march.
choices.epitaph: Denied hydration request. The traveler resumed their march.

quests.trigger: An elderly survivor in terminal decline requests company and rations.
quests.discovery: An old woman sits against a wall, her breathing shallow and arrhythmic. 'My timetable is short. But a human voice would be an acceptable variable.'

choices.label: Give food and medicine
choices.outcome_text: You expend rations and medicine. She acknowledges the transaction and provides the coordinates of her family's sealed bunker.
choices.epitaph: Expended medical and food stores on terminal subject. Received bunker coordinates.

choices.label: Give some supplies
choices.outcome_text: You leave a partial supply cache. She registers the gesture, extending her final hours slightly.
choices.epitaph: Allocated partial supplies to terminal subject. Marginally extended her timeline.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You provide presence without expenditure. She accepts the parameters without complaint.
choices.epitaph: Provided observation without supply expenditure. Subject accepted the protocol.

choices.label: Take her supplies
choices.outcome_text: Her inventory is negligible, but you requisition it. She lacks the lung capacity to protest.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned terminal subject's inventory. Minimal yield.

quests.trigger: A woman in active labor arrives at an abandoned medical outpost.
quests.discovery: A woman leans against the doorframe, timing contractions. 'The interval is dropping. Delivery is imminent,' she states.

choices.label: Give all your medical supplies
choices.outcome_text: You allocate all sterile supplies and antiseptic. A viable infant is delivered. They assign your designation to the child as a marker of debt.
choices.epitaph: Expended full medical kit on field delivery. The viable infant carries my designation.

choices.label: Give some supplies
choices.outcome_text: You allocate sufficient supplies for basic sanitation. The delivery is within acceptable mortality parameters.
choices.epitaph: Allocated partial medical supplies. Ensured delivery met sanitation thresholds.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You retain your kit. She proceeds with unassisted delivery in the dark.
choices.epitaph: Withheld medical supplies. Subject proceeded with unassisted delivery.

choices.label: Take her supplies
choices.outcome_text: You requisition her operational go-bag. She expends energy screaming until the contractions override her vocal cords.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned supplies during active labor. Subject vocalized distress until incapacitated.

quests.trigger: A wounded hostile combatant with an inoperable weapon requests aid.
quests.discovery: A raider lies bleeding in the dirt, their firearm visibly fractured. 'I am unarmed and bleeding out. Requesting quarter,' they state, formally submitting.

choices.label: Give medical supplies
choices.outcome_text: You dress the wound. They assess your utility, then dictate their faction's next patrol schedule as payment.
choices.epitaph: Treated hostile combatant. Acquired patrol schedules as payment.

choices.label: Give food
choices.outcome_text: You transfer a standard ration. They consume it rapidly while monitoring their perimeter.
choices.epitaph: Transferred rations to hostile combatant. Subject prioritized immediate consumption.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You maintain operational distance. They expel saliva in your direction; it falls short.
choices.epitaph: Maintained distance from hostile combatant. Ignored minor provocation.

choices.label: Finish them
choices.outcome_text: You execute the subject. They spend their last breath updating their faction's threat assessment on you.
choices.epitaph: Executed hostile combatant. Expected reprisal logged.

quests.trigger: An ambushed Peacekeeper operative is incapacitated on a primary route.
quests.discovery: A Peacekeeper leans against a rusted chassis, uniform compromised, right leg non-weight-bearing. 'Ambush protocol failed. Requesting medical evac,' they report.

choices.label: Give all your supplies
choices.outcome_text: You treat the trauma and transfer stores. In exchange: safehouse ciphers, patrol frequencies, and an official commendation.
choices.epitaph: Provided full medical aid to Peacekeeper operative. Acquired safehouse ciphers.

choices.label: Give some supplies
choices.outcome_text: You allocate sufficient supplies to stabilize. They log a formal note of gratitude and initiate self-extraction.
choices.epitaph: Stabilized Peacekeeper operative. Subject initiated self-extraction.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You proceed without deviation. They visually record your physical parameters for future reference.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed Peacekeeper operative. Subject logged my physical description.

choices.label: Take their supplies
choices.outcome_text: You requisition their standard-issue kit. They attempt physical resistance with one arm; it is mathematically insufficient.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned Peacekeeper kit. Encounter logged as hostile act.

quests.trigger: A Knowledge Keeper with compromised optics reports caloric deficiency.
quests.discovery: An archivist sits over a dead radio, glasses mended with copper wire. 'Optical inputs compromised. Caloric reserves critical,' they report.

choices.label: Give food and spare glasses
choices.outcome_text: You provide rations and spare lenses. They read a pre-war topographic survey aloud, then transfer the physical document.
choices.epitaph: Restored archivist's optical and caloric capacity. Acquired pre-war topographic data.

choices.label: Give food only
choices.outcome_text: You transfer calories. They dictate memorized coordinates, verifying them against mental ledgers.
choices.epitaph: Provided calories to archivist. Transcribed dictated coordinates.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You leave them to their visual degradation and empty stores.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed compromised archivist. Left them to the dark.

choices.label: Take their notes
choices.outcome_text: You requisition their survey notes. They vocalize intense distress, treating the data loss as physical trauma.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned archivist's data. Subject exhibited high distress.

quests.trigger: A local warlord who previously granted safe passage is cataloging ammunition.
quests.discovery: The warlord who cleared you last winter sits by a low thermal pit, counting brass. 'We established a precedent of mutual survival. Let us see if it holds.'

choices.label: Give them supplies
choices.outcome_text: You transfer the requested supplies. They register the payment. The route remains clear.
choices.epitaph: Paid supply toll to local warlord. Maintained route clearance.

choices.label: Give them nothing
choices.outcome_text: You decline the transaction. They acknowledge the refusal without hostility. A calculated test.
choices.epitaph: Refused warlord's supply request. Maintained diplomatic neutrality.

choices.label: Take their supplies
choices.outcome_text: You attempt a hostile requisition. They exhibit mild amusement and permit you to retreat.
choices.epitaph: Failed hostile requisition on warlord. Subject permitted retreat.

quests.trigger: A radiation-compromised specialist requests pharmaceutical intervention.
quests.discovery: A specialist coughs, exhibiting advanced acute radiation syndrome. 'Require chemical intervention. Have data to trade,' they state, surrounded by decay charts.

choices.label: Give all your medicine
choices.outcome_text: You transfer your pharmaceutical inventory. Stabilized, they dictate a highly efficient chelation protocol.
choices.epitaph: Expended pharmaceuticals on specialist. Acquired optimized chelation protocol.

choices.label: Give some medicine
choices.outcome_text: You transfer partial inventory. They stabilize sufficiently to transcribe the formula onto a structural beam.
choices.epitaph: Transferred partial pharmaceuticals. Specialist transcribed data prior to expiry.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You retain your inventory. They resume calculating their own decay rate.
choices.epitaph: Retained pharmaceutical inventory. Subject returned to terminal calculations.

choices.label: Take their research
choices.outcome_text: You requisition the data binder. They vocalize a curse, interrupted by respiratory failure.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned specialist's data binder. Subject expired during transfer.

quests.trigger: A soil engineer assesses completely compromised crop rows.
quests.discovery: The engineer kneels in irradiated dirt, assessing total yield failure. 'The soil is sterile. We require viable inputs.'

choices.label: Give seeds and fertilizer
choices.outcome_text: You transfer viable seed stock and chemical inputs. They calculate a 40% yield return as your dividend.
choices.epitaph: Transferred agricultural inputs. Secured a 40% dividend on future yields.

choices.label: Give some supplies
choices.outcome_text: You transfer partial inputs. They revise the yield estimates downward, but honor a proportional dividend.
choices.epitaph: Transferred partial inputs. Secured a proportional dividend on reduced yield.

choices.label: Give nothing
choices.outcome_text: You observe the sterile soil and depart.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed compromised agricultural sector. Yield remains zero.

choices.label: Steal their seeds
choices.outcome_text: You requisition their remaining sterile seed stock. They pursue to the perimeter, escalating to hostile status.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned remaining agricultural stock. Subject escalated to hostile.

quests.trigger: An elderly survivor offers civic infrastructure schematics disguised as anecdotes.
quests.discovery: An elderly male feeds a small thermal fire. 'I was a municipal planner. I know where the deep conduits run. But I only deliver data in narrative format.'

choices.label: Process the narrative
choices.outcome_text: You process the inefficient delivery method. Mid-story, he embeds the coordinates for an intact subsurface bunker.
choices.epitaph: Processed civic worker's narrative. Extracted bunker coordinates.

choices.label: Record the complete session
choices.outcome_text: You endure the full session. He concludes by transferring ownership of a secondary supply cache.
choices.epitaph: Recorded complete civic narrative. Acquired secondary cache location.

choices.label: Interrupt and abort
choices.outcome_text: You abort the session due to inefficiency. He ceases audio output.
choices.epitaph: Aborted inefficient data transfer. No coordinates acquired.

choices.label: Mock the obsolete data
choices.outcome_text: You point out the city no longer exists. He registers the comment and permanently encrypts his memory.
choices.epitaph: Mocked obsolete civic data. Subject locked all further output.

quests.trigger: A female survivor maintains a cradle containing zero biological assets.
quests.discovery: A woman manually rocks an empty bassinet. 'She would have reached five years of operational capacity this winter,' she states to the room.

choices.label: Provide observational presence
choices.outcome_text: You maintain presence until the psychological loop closes. She transfers a pre-war mechanical toy to your inventory as compensation.
choices.epitaph: Provided presence during psychological loop. Received mechanical toy.

choices.label: Maintain silence
choices.outcome_text: You observe without vocalizing. The uninterrupted processing time stabilizes her metrics.
choices.epitaph: Maintained silence. Facilitated subject's emotional processing.

choices.label: Disengage
choices.outcome_text: You retreat from the zone. The mechanical rocking continues.
choices.epitaph: Disengaged from non-productive interaction. Preserved schedule.

choices.label: Criticize the resource waste
choices.outcome_text: You point out the caloric waste of rocking an empty box. Her distress vocalizations alert nearby hostiles.
choices.epitaph: Criticized resource waste. Triggered hostile-alerting distress.

quests.trigger: A former combatant offers an unsolicited after-action report.
quests.discovery: A combatant unnecessarily sharpens a combat knife. 'Requesting audience for an after-action report of the Exchange,' they state. It is not phrased as a question.

choices.label: Accept the debrief
choices.outcome_text: You process the full tactical review. Afterward, they recalibrate your rifle's optics to military specification.
choices.epitaph: Accepted tactical debrief. Rifle optics recalibrated to spec.

choices.label: Cross-examine the report
choices.outcome_text: You point out logistical contradictions in their timeline. They acknowledge the corrections and provide verified intel.
choices.epitaph: Cross-examined combat report. Extracted verified tactical intel.

choices.label: Decline the report
choices.outcome_text: You decline the data transfer. The knife sharpening resumes its original rhythm.
choices.epitaph: Declined tactical debrief. Proceeded on schedule.

choices.label: Mock their unit
choices.outcome_text: You disparage their unit's operational failure. They draw the knife. You expend resources to survive the ensuing correction.
choices.epitaph: Mocked combatant's unit. Suffered physical correction.

quests.trigger: A juvenile survivor requests to transfer an unverified astronomical theory.
quests.discovery: A juvenile subject initiates physical contact. 'Requesting permission to transfer data regarding stellar bodies,' they state, exhibiting elevated heart rate.

choices.label: Authorize data transfer
choices.outcome_text: You process the narrative. They generate a hand-drawn celestial map and assign your designation to a star cluster.
choices.epitaph: Authorized juvenile data transfer. Received hand-drawn celestial map.

choices.label: Acknowledge the data
choices.outcome_text: You provide basic affirmations. The subject registers the interaction as a success.
choices.epitaph: Acknowledged juvenile astronomical theory. Interaction logged as successful.

choices.label: Deny transfer
choices.outcome_text: You deny the request due to irrelevance. The physical contact is terminated.
choices.epitaph: Denied irrelevant data transfer. Physical contact terminated.

choices.label: Invalidate the theory
choices.outcome_text: You inform them the stars are occluded by particulate matter. They cease interaction without vocalizing.
choices.epitaph: Invalidated astronomical theory. Subject ceased interaction.

quests.trigger: A former medical officer wishes to detail their triage protocol failures.
quests.discovery: A field surgeon cleans instruments with industrial solvent. 'I need to formally log the black tags I issued during the first week,' they state, staring at the wall.

choices.label: Listen to the log
choices.outcome_text: You record the names and rationales. Relieved of the data, they provide a key to an intact pharmacy lockbox.
choices.epitaph: Recorded triage logs. Acquired pharmacy lockbox key.

choices.label: Acknowledge the necessity
choices.outcome_text: You validate the resource calculations that led to the black tags. The surgeon's vitals stabilize.
choices.epitaph: Validated triage protocols. Surgeon's psychological metrics stabilized.

choices.label: Decline the data
choices.outcome_text: You decline to serve as a data repository. They return to sterilizing instruments.
choices.epitaph: Declined to record triage logs. Surgeon resumed sterilization.

choices.label: Condemn the protocol
choices.outcome_text: You criticize their failure to save all assets. They lock you out of all future medical assistance.
choices.epitaph: Condemned triage protocols. Surgeon revoked future medical aid.

quests.trigger: A self-appointed chaplain offers a doctrinal broadcast on the Exchange.
quests.discovery: A figure in ash-stained vestments intercepts you. 'Will you receive the theological context for the thermal events?' they inquire.

choices.label: Receive the broadcast
choices.outcome_text: You process the sermon. They interpret your patience as piety and bless your weapon.
choices.epitaph: Processed doctrinal broadcast. Weapon received theological blessing.

choices.label: Debate the doctrine
choices.outcome_text: You highlight logical fallacies in their theology. They appreciate the rigorous peer review.
choices.epitaph: Debated theology. Chaplain appreciated the rigorous peer review.

choices.label: Bypass the chaplain
choices.outcome_text: You maintain your vector. The broadcast continues to an empty grid.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed chaplain. Sermon broadcasted to empty grid.

choices.label: Terminate the broadcast
choices.outcome_text: You threaten violence if the audio output continues. They label you a hostile theological entity.
choices.epitaph: Terminated doctrinal broadcast. Designated as hostile entity.

quests.trigger: An engineer wants to detail the exact failure mode of the local bridge.
quests.discovery: An engineer points at the collapsed overpass. 'The rebar sheared due to thermal shock, not impact. Allow me to explain the mathematics.'

choices.label: Process the mathematics
choices.outcome_text: You review the structural math. They reward your attention by revealing the location of the maintenance sub-level.
choices.epitaph: Processed structural post-mortem. Acquired maintenance sub-level coordinates.

choices.label: Acknowledge the failure
choices.outcome_text: You nod at the physics equations. They seem satisfied that the data has been preserved.
choices.epitaph: Acknowledged structural failure modes. Preserved the engineer's data.

choices.label: Ignore the analysis
choices.outcome_text: You ignore the math and navigate the rubble.
choices.epitaph: Ignored structural analysis. Navigated rubble inefficiently.

choices.label: Blame the engineering
choices.outcome_text: You blame their guild for the collapse. They throw a sheared bolt at you, missing by a wide margin.
choices.epitaph: Assigned blame for structural collapse. Evaded projectile.

quests.trigger: A paranoid survivor insists on delivering a high-priority threat assessment.
quests.discovery: A survivor with elevated adrenaline levels blocks your path. 'The ash is anomalous. There are entities in the cloud layer. You must record this.'

choices.label: Log the assessment
choices.outcome_text: You log the paranoid data. They calm down and hand you a crude, but effective, particulate filter.
choices.epitaph: Logged unverified threat assessment. Received functional particulate filter.

choices.label: Question the data
choices.outcome_text: You demand empirical evidence. They cannot provide it, but appreciate the scientific rigor.
choices.epitaph: Demanded empirical evidence for threat assessment. Data remains unverified.

choices.label: Dismiss the assessment
choices.outcome_text: You classify the data as hallucination and proceed.
choices.epitaph: Dismissed threat assessment as hallucination.

choices.label: Incapacitate the subject
choices.outcome_text: You use physical force to clear the path. They add you to their list of anomalous threats.
choices.epitaph: Incapacitated paranoid subject. Registered as secondary threat.

choices.label: Mock their fear
choices.outcome_text: You laugh at them and take the road they feared, loudly. The road takes the joke badly.
choices.epitaph: Mocked the warning and walked right in. Paid for the joke.

quests.trigger: A survivor by a fire tells of love before the exchange.
quests.discovery: A woman feeds photographs to the fire one at a time, not burning them — warming them. 'He used to bring me flowers. Before everything changed,' she says.

choices.label: Listen sympathetically
choices.outcome_text: You hear it through. At the end she gives you the last photograph, kept whole — 'someone should carry it forward.'
choices.epitaph: Heard her whole story. She gave me the last photo to carry forward.

choices.label: Listen politely
choices.outcome_text: You nod at the right beats. She keeps one photograph and lets you see it.
choices.epitaph: Listened to the lover's tale. She showed me the last photo.

choices.label: Interrupt or leave
choices.outcome_text: You leave her to the photographs.
choices.epitaph: Left her to her photographs. The fire was doing its slow work.

choices.label: Laugh at the romance
choices.outcome_text: You laugh at flowers. She stands up. The night rearranges itself.
choices.epitaph: Laughed at the flowers. She stood up and the night changed shape.

quests.trigger: A former teacher offers a lesson on the world before.
quests.discovery: A woman with cracked glasses and a straight back looks you over. 'You could use some education. Let me tell you about the world before,' she says, and it starts exactly on time.

choices.label: Listen attentively
choices.outcome_text: Hours pass like minutes. You leave reading the signage on the dead roads.
choices.epitaph: Sat through the teacher's whole lesson. I can read the road signs now.

choices.label: Listen, but bored
choices.outcome_text: You fidget through half. She assigns you homework — a sign to read on your way out.
choices.epitaph: Half-listened to the lesson. She left me homework. I did it.

choices.label: Interrupt or leave
choices.outcome_text: You've survived this long without the old world. You go.
choices.epitaph: Walked out of the schoolroom. Survived fine. Know less.

choices.label: Mock her teaching
choices.outcome_text: You tell her the old world is dead weight. She closes the book gently, like a coffin lid.
choices.epitaph: Mocked the teacher's old world. She closed the book on me.

quests.trigger: You catch a young thief with your gear — and an explanation.
quests.discovery: A young man freezes with your flashlight halfway into his coat. 'I can explain. I was going to pay you back,' he says fast, and mostly means it.

choices.label: Hear the explanation
choices.outcome_text: His sister is coughing somewhere. You listen, then let him keep the light. He becomes useful after that.
choices.epitaph: Heard the thief out. Let him keep the light. He's been useful since.

choices.label: Listen, skeptical
choices.outcome_text: You question the story. Half of it holds. He returns half of what he took.
choices.epitaph: Questioned the thief's story. Half held up. Half came back.

choices.label: Report them to the camp
choices.outcome_text: You hand him to the watch. The camp handles it. His sister's cough handles itself.
choices.epitaph: Turned the thief in. The camp was thorough. I didn't stay to learn the rest.

choices.label: Take more from them
choices.outcome_text: You take from him what he took from you, plus interest. He doesn't argue. He remembers.
choices.epitaph: Took back my gear and then some. He didn't argue. He'll remember.

quests.trigger: A wild-eyed man says the stars speak to him.
quests.discovery: A wild-eyed man points at the smoke-stained sky like it owes him money. 'The stars speak to me! Want to hear their message?' he asks, urgent as weather.

choices.label: Hear the vision
choices.outcome_text: The vision is nonsense stitched with coordinates. You use the coordinates. They're real.
choices.epitaph: Heard the prophet's vision. The message was madness with a map in it — the map was real.

choices.label: Listen skeptically
choices.outcome_text: You sort the signal from the noise with him. Half the message survives your doubts, and half of that is useful.
choices.epitaph: Argued the prophet's vision into sense. Kept the parts that held.

choices.label: Interrupt or leave
choices.outcome_text: You have messages of your own to deliver — to anywhere but here.
choices.epitaph: Left the prophet to his stars. They talk only to him.

choices.label: Mock the visions
choices.outcome_text: You laugh at the stars. He goes very still and says your name, which you never gave him.
choices.epitaph: Mocked the prophet's stars. He said my name. I never gave it.

quests.trigger: A survivor registers the cessation of their partner's biological functions.
quests.discovery: A woman sits next to a fresh mound of turned earth, staring at a static point. 'His biometric monitor went flat. The unit is permanently offline,' she states.

choices.label: Maintain observational presence
choices.outcome_text: You stand watch during her psychological loop. When she breaks it, she transfers his insulated coat to you. 'An asset should be deployed, not buried.'
choices.epitaph: Maintained watch for bereaved partner. Received functional insulated coat.

choices.label: Validate the data
choices.outcome_text: You confirm the finality of the cessation. She accepts the verification and begins gathering her gear.
choices.epitaph: Validated cessation of biological functions. Subject initiated departure protocol.

choices.label: Disengage
choices.outcome_text: You bypass the coordinates. The mourning period is not a tactical factor.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed bereaved partner. Conserved operational time.

choices.label: Criticize the emotional expenditure
choices.outcome_text: You point out the caloric waste of mourning. She registers your designation on a reprisal ledger.
choices.epitaph: Criticized caloric waste of mourning. Added to reprisal ledger.

quests.trigger: A juvenile subject experiences extreme nocturnal distress.
quests.discovery: A juvenile thrashes on a sleep mat, experiencing a severe REM-cycle distress event. 'Hostiles! They are breaching the perimeter!' they shout in their sleep.

choices.label: Initialize gentle wake protocol
choices.outcome_text: You extract them from the REM cycle carefully. They recalibrate to reality and offer you a crude map of local salvage.
choices.epitaph: Extracted juvenile from distress event. Acquired crude salvage map.

choices.label: Initialize rapid wake protocol
choices.outcome_text: You apply physical force to terminate the cycle. They awake rapidly, experiencing elevated cortisol levels but ceasing noise.
choices.epitaph: Applied physical force to terminate distress. Cortisol levels elevated.

choices.label: Ignore the event
choices.outcome_text: You disregard the auditory interference. The REM cycle eventually concludes on its own.
choices.epitaph: Disregarded juvenile distress event. Cycle concluded naturally.

choices.label: Suppress the noise
choices.outcome_text: You demand auditory compliance. The child ceases screaming but exhibits profound psychological withdrawal.
choices.epitaph: Suppressed juvenile auditory output. Subject exhibited withdrawal.

quests.trigger: A survivor with severe trauma requires psychological stabilization.
quests.discovery: A survivor clutches a severe abdominal wound, respiration shallow. They have ceased vocalizing distress, indicating imminent shock.

choices.label: Provide psychological stabilization
choices.outcome_text: You provide vocal anchors to delay shock onset. They dictate a debt of life before losing consciousness.
choices.epitaph: Delayed shock onset via vocal anchors. Subject registered life debt.

choices.label: Apply standard first aid
choices.outcome_text: You apply pressure and bindings. Physical stabilization is achieved, though psychological trauma remains unaddressed.
choices.epitaph: Applied physical stabilization. Psychological trauma unaddressed.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You maintain your patrol vector. Shock will likely claim the asset within the hour.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed compromised asset. Imminent shock predicted.

choices.label: Expedite expiry
choices.outcome_text: You physically displace them from your path. The kinetic impact accelerates the onset of shock.
choices.epitaph: Displaced compromised asset physically. Accelerated shock onset.

quests.trigger: A survivor experiences paralyzing panic in an enclosed space.
quests.discovery: A survivor kneels in the far corner of a cellar, hands covering auditory receptors. 'Sensory deprivation is triggering a panic response,' they report, respiration elevated.

choices.label: Provide cognitive grounding
choices.outcome_text: You provide constant vocal input until their respiration normalizes. They reorganize your inventory as compensation.
choices.epitaph: Provided cognitive grounding during panic event. Received inventory reorganization.

choices.label: Deploy illumination
choices.outcome_text: You leave a low-yield chemical light. The visual input prevents further panic escalation.
choices.epitaph: Deployed chemical light to mitigate sensory deprivation.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You ignore the compromised asset. The panic response isolates them effectively.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed compromised asset. Panic response permitted to run its course.

choices.label: Amplify the stimuli
choices.outcome_text: You strike the pipes to generate acoustic shock. They enter a catatonic state.
choices.epitaph: Amplified panic stimuli. Subject entered catatonic state.

quests.trigger: A survivor experiences severe chemical withdrawal symptoms.
quests.discovery: A survivor exhibits acute tremors and diaphoresis. 'Receptor deprivation is reaching critical thresholds. Require chemical input,' they state, struggling for motor control.

choices.label: Provide supervised withdrawal
choices.outcome_text: You monitor their vitals through the peak withdrawal window. They log their first clean operational day.
choices.epitaph: Supervised chemical withdrawal. Subject logged first clean operational day.

choices.label: Administer placebo
choices.outcome_text: You administer a biologically inert compound. The psychosomatic effect mitigates the tremors temporarily.
choices.epitaph: Administered inert compound. Achieved psychosomatic tremor mitigation.

choices.label: Administer the narcotic
choices.outcome_text: You supply the requested compound. Tremors cease instantly. Long-term operational viability is reduced.
choices.epitaph: Supplied requested narcotic. Achieved immediate stabilization at long-term cost.

choices.label: Exploit the vulnerability
choices.outcome_text: You promise the compound in exchange for their gear, then withhold it. The transaction is highly efficient.
choices.epitaph: Exploited chemical dependency for material gain. Transaction highly efficient.

quests.trigger: A survivor fixates on their improbable survival rate.
quests.discovery: A survivor calculates mortality statistics aloud. 'My survival represents a statistical anomaly. The probability of my unit's termination was 98.7%.'

choices.label: Contextualize the data
choices.outcome_text: You explain that statistical anomalies are inherent to large datasets. They accept the logic and provide access to a secured radio frequency.
choices.epitaph: Contextualized mortality statistics. Acquired secured radio frequency.

choices.label: Acknowledge the probability
choices.outcome_text: You agree that their survival is mathematically unlikely. The validation reduces their cognitive dissonance.
choices.epitaph: Validated statistical anomaly. Reduced subject's cognitive dissonance.

choices.label: Ignore the calculations
choices.outcome_text: You allow them to continue calculating. It does not affect your operational readiness.
choices.epitaph: Ignored statistical calculations. Maintained operational readiness.

choices.label: Assign blame
choices.outcome_text: You suggest their survival was purchased via the termination of others. The variable permanently corrupts their logic loop.
choices.epitaph: Suggested survival was zero-sum. Permanently corrupted subject's logic loop.

quests.trigger: An older survivor attempts to transmit accumulated operational data.
quests.discovery: An older male indicates a seating area. 'I have accumulated significant localized data. I require a secondary storage unit to ensure redundancy.'

choices.label: Download the data
choices.outcome_text: You process data on flood patterns and filter maintenance. He transfers a high-quality folding blade as a receipt.
choices.epitaph: Downloaded archival operational data. Received folding blade as receipt.

choices.label: Download critical subsets
choices.outcome_text: You limit the transfer to immediate survival protocols. He provides the blade anyway, acknowledging your efficiency.
choices.epitaph: Downloaded critical data subsets only. Efficiency acknowledged.

choices.label: Decline the transfer
choices.outcome_text: You decline the data upload. You rely on your own localized processing.
choices.epitaph: Declined archival data transfer. Relied on localized processing.

choices.label: Mock the hardware
choices.outcome_text: You suggest his biological hardware is failing. He logs the insult and terminates the connection.
choices.epitaph: Insulted subject's biological hardware. Connection terminated.

quests.trigger: An adjacent asset experiences extreme REM-cycle distress.
quests.discovery: An adjacent survivor thrashes violently during a sleep cycle. 'Proximity alert! Engage!' they shout, striking the insulated mat.

choices.label: Execute controlled wake
choices.outcome_text: You initialize a low-volume wake protocol, keeping your hands visible. The subject calibrates successfully and shares caloric intake the next day.
choices.epitaph: Executed controlled wake protocol. Asset shared caloric resources.

choices.label: Execute rapid wake
choices.outcome_text: You physically jar the subject from the REM cycle. Consciousness is achieved immediately. Proximity protocols are heightened thereafter.
choices.epitaph: Executed rapid wake protocol. Asset increased proximity protocols.

choices.label: Maintain cycle
choices.outcome_text: You block auditory input and maintain your own rest cycle. The distress is not your parameter.
choices.epitaph: Blocked auditory input. Maintained personal rest cycle.

choices.label: Trigger defense response
choices.outcome_text: You trigger a proximity alarm to evaluate their combat readiness. The resulting physiological stress is profound.
choices.epitaph: Triggered defense response during REM cycle. Assessed profound physiological stress.

quests.trigger: A survivor reports severe social deprivation.
quests.discovery: A survivor monitors the perimeter statically. 'Vocal interaction metric has been zero for three operational weeks,' they state, directing the data to you.

choices.label: Provide vocal interaction
choices.outcome_text: You exchange low-value data for two hours. They transfer excess rations as payment for the interaction.
choices.epitaph: Provided vocal interaction. Received ration transfer as payment.

choices.label: Acknowledge the data
choices.outcome_text: You confirm the zero metric is within normal parameters. They register the confirmation.
choices.epitaph: Confirmed social deprivation metric. Subject registered confirmation.

choices.label: Maintain vector
choices.outcome_text: You bypass the unit. Social metrics are not a priority parameter.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed isolated unit. Social metrics de-prioritized.

choices.label: Criticize dependency
choices.outcome_text: You point out that vocalization is a vulnerability. They concur, terminating the interaction permanently.
choices.epitaph: Criticized social dependency. Subject terminated interaction.

quests.trigger: A survivor experiences an acute emotional destabilization event.
quests.discovery: A survivor exhibits maximum-volume vocalization toward the upper atmosphere. 'THE METRICS ARE UNSUSTAINABLE!' they shout, displaying combat-level muscle tension.

choices.label: Monitor until normalization
choices.outcome_text: You maintain a safe radius until cortisol levels drop. The subject then provides a detailed ledger of their lost assets.
choices.epitaph: Monitored destabilization event. Received detailed ledger of lost assets.

choices.label: Provide verbal de-escalation
choices.outcome_text: You issue a low-volume de-escalation prompt. Vocal volume decreases, though physiological tension remains.
choices.epitaph: Issued de-escalation prompt. Achieved partial physiological stabilization.

choices.label: Maintain safe radius
choices.outcome_text: You calculate a safe radius and wait for the energy expenditure to conclude.
choices.epitaph: Maintained safe radius during destabilization event.

choices.label: Provoke physical response
choices.outcome_text: You validate the unsustainability of the metrics. The subject redirects the hostility toward your physical form.
choices.epitaph: Provoked physical response. Subject initiated combat.

quests.trigger: A survivor proposes a highly improbable infrastructure project.
quests.discovery: A survivor presents a hand-drawn schematic of a repaired structural support. 'Structural integrity can be restored. The mathematical probability is non-zero,' they state.

choices.label: Validate the schematic
choices.outcome_text: You confirm the mathematics. You are immediately assigned a labor quota for the project.
choices.epitaph: Validated infrastructure schematic. Accepted labor quota.

choices.label: Process the data
choices.outcome_text: You review the schematic. Certain load-bearing equations are theoretically sound.
choices.epitaph: Processed infrastructure schematic. Confirmed theoretical soundness.

choices.label: Ignore the proposal
choices.outcome_text: You decline to review the equations. Infrastructure is not your current directive.
choices.epitaph: Declined infrastructure review. Maintained current directives.

choices.label: Correct the mathematics
choices.outcome_text: You point out the critical resource deficit required for execution. The subject terminates the project.
choices.epitaph: Corrected mathematical projection. Project terminated due to resource deficit.

quests.trigger: A survivor calculates their inevitable mortality.
quests.discovery: A survivor sits against a reinforced wall. 'Given the caloric deficit and radiation half-lives, survival is a mathematical impossibility,' they state.

choices.label: Adjust the parameters
choices.outcome_text: You re-frame the timeframe to a 24-hour cycle. The abbreviated horizon stabilizes their logic loop.
choices.epitaph: Adjusted survival timeframe to 24-hour cycle. Stabilized subject's logic loop.

choices.label: Provide standard platitudes
choices.outcome_text: You issue generic survival directives. The data is processed without significant behavioral change.
choices.epitaph: Issued generic survival directives. Behavioral change negligible.

choices.label: Confirm the mathematics
choices.outcome_text: You verify their calculations. You proceed, conserving your own resources.
choices.epitaph: Verified subject's terminal mathematics. Conserved personal resources.

choices.label: Classify as dead weight
choices.outcome_text: You point out they are currently consuming oxygen better utilized by viable assets. They cease breathing shortly after.
choices.epitaph: Classified subject as non-viable. Subject terminated biological functions.

quests.trigger: You locate an improvised grave lacking identification.
quests.discovery: A shallow depression in the ash, filled and packed by a boot. No registration tags. The asset was discarded rapidly.

choices.label: Log coordinates
choices.outcome_text: You log the coordinates and place a recognizable marker. Future patrols will avoid the biological hazard.
choices.epitaph: Logged coordinates of unregistered burial. Prevented biological hazard exposure.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You proceed. Discarded assets require no operational overhead.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed unregistered burial. Conserved operational overhead.

choices.label: Exhume for analysis
choices.outcome_text: You dig. The decomposition provides little actionable data, but expends your calories.
choices.epitaph: Exhumed unregistered grave. Caloric expenditure exceeded data yield.

choices.label: Requisition buried assets
choices.outcome_text: You extract usable material from the grave. The gear is functional but requires immediate decontamination.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned buried assets. Immediate decontamination required.

quests.trigger: You encounter remains subjected to extreme thermal events.
quests.discovery: A biological unit reduced to carbonized slag. The thermal event was localized and instantaneous. Identification is impossible.

choices.label: Neutralize the hazard
choices.outcome_text: You collapse the surrounding structure to contain the carbonized dust. The area is marked as a hazard zone.
choices.epitaph: Contained thermal casualty dust. Marked hazard zone.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You maintain distance. Carbonized remains present low immediate threat.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed thermal casualty. Maintained operational distance.

choices.label: Extract thermal-resistant gear
choices.outcome_text: You retrieve items that survived the thermal spike. They are scorched but functional.
choices.epitaph: Extracted thermal-resistant gear from casualty. Functionality confirmed.

choices.label: Disturb the remains
choices.outcome_text: You displace the carbonized structure. The resulting dust coats your filters.
choices.epitaph: Displaced carbonized remains. Degraded filter integrity.

quests.trigger: A decomposing biological unit threatens a local water source.
quests.discovery: A bloated corpse rests in the intake flow of a local water supply. Bacterial bloom is imminent. The threat to public health is acute.

choices.label: Extract and isolate
choices.outcome_text: You expend significant calories dragging the contaminant away from the watershed. The local supply remains viable.
choices.epitaph: Extracted biological contaminant from watershed. Preserved local water supply.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You map the water source as compromised and proceed. Other units will require the same data.
choices.epitaph: Mapped water source as compromised. Relied on alternative supplies.

choices.label: Extract carelessly
choices.outcome_text: You haul the unit out without containment protocols. The resulting fluid leak contaminates your immediate gear.
choices.epitaph: Extracted contaminant without protocols. Gear required immediate decontamination.

choices.label: Dislodge downstream
choices.outcome_text: You force the blockage downstream. The flow clears, transferring the biological hazard to another sector.
choices.epitaph: Dislodged contaminant downstream. Transferred biological hazard to unknown sector.

quests.trigger: You locate the remains of a pre-war juvenile.
quests.discovery: A small skeleton in a ruined residential structure. It is clutching a degraded polymer toy. The biological matter has entirely dessicated.

choices.label: Execute burial protocol
choices.outcome_text: You expend calories to bury the remains and the polymer object. A passing scavenger observes the protocol and nods once.
choices.epitaph: Executed burial protocol for juvenile remains. Acknowledged by local scavenger.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You leave the structure. The remains do not present an immediate biohazard.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed juvenile remains. Confirmed lack of biohazard.

choices.label: Extract polymer asset
choices.outcome_text: You break the finger bones to extract the polymer object. It has minor barter value.
choices.epitaph: Extracted polymer asset from juvenile remains. Barter value confirmed.

choices.label: Search the remains
choices.outcome_text: You displace the bones searching for high-value items. The caloric expenditure yields nothing.
choices.epitaph: Displaced juvenile remains during search. Caloric expenditure wasted.

quests.trigger: You discover a high-density casualty disposal pit.
quests.discovery: A mechanically excavated pit containing dozens of bodies. The layering indicates a rapid, systematic disposal event, likely early post-exchange.

choices.label: Log as historical site
choices.outcome_text: You map the coordinates and designate it a memorial zone on your local network. You leave a single ration as a marker.
choices.epitaph: Mapped high-density disposal site. Designated memorial zone.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: The disposal is complete. You walk the perimeter and proceed.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed high-density disposal site.

choices.label: Extract surface textiles
choices.outcome_text: The uppermost layer retains viable textiles. You strip a functional coat. Decontamination will be difficult.
choices.epitaph: Extracted textiles from mass disposal site. Decontamination required.

choices.label: Execute thermal containment
choices.outcome_text: You ignite the pit to neutralize potential pathogens. The smoke column alerts nearby factions to your position.
choices.epitaph: Executed thermal containment on disposal site. Position broadcast via smoke column.

quests.trigger: You encounter a body suspended from civil infrastructure.
quests.discovery: A body hangs from a highway gantry via synthetic rope. The knot indicates systematic execution rather than self-termination.

choices.label: Sever suspension and bury
choices.outcome_text: You expend the time to cut the line and inter the body. The infrastructure is cleared of obstructions.
choices.epitaph: Severed suspension and interred body. Infrastructure obstruction cleared.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You maintain your route. The execution is not your parameter.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed suspended casualty. Execution parameters ignored.

choices.label: Sever suspension only
choices.outcome_text: You drop the body to clear the visual hazard, but conserve calories by declining burial.
choices.epitaph: Severed suspension to clear visual hazard. Burial declined to conserve calories.

choices.label: Requisition suspension line
choices.outcome_text: You sever the rope at the high point and leave the body to fall. The synthetic line is highly valuable.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned synthetic suspension line. Casualty discarded.

quests.trigger: You locate skeletal remains in a sealed residential storage unit.
quests.discovery: A skeleton is wedged into a bedroom closet, covered by a wool coat. The interior locking mechanism indicates they sought containment before expiry.

choices.label: Execute extraction and burial
choices.outcome_text: You extract the remains and bury them in the adjacent soil. The structure is now cleared for your use.
choices.epitaph: Extracted and buried concealed remains. Residential structure cleared.

choices.label: Reseal containment
choices.outcome_text: You close the door. The remains are self-contained and pose no threat.
choices.epitaph: Resealed containment on skeletal remains. Threat level zero.

choices.label: Extract thermal insulation
choices.outcome_text: You pull the wool coat free. The skeleton collapses. The insulation value is high.
choices.epitaph: Extracted wool insulation from concealed remains. Structural collapse of skeleton noted.

choices.label: Execute thermal sterilization
choices.outcome_text: You ignite the closet to neutralize unknown pathogens. The residential structure sustains severe fire damage.
choices.epitaph: Executed thermal sterilization on concealed remains. Structural damage sustained.

quests.trigger: You encounter a submerged casualty in a flooded sector.
quests.discovery: A body floats face-down in standing water. The decomposition process is accelerating, compromising the local filtration math.

choices.label: Extract to dry ground
choices.outcome_text: You drag the mass onto dry concrete and execute a shallow burial. The water quality metrics stabilize marginally.
choices.epitaph: Extracted aqueous contaminant to dry ground. Water metrics stabilized.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You log the standing water as non-potable and proceed.
choices.epitaph: Logged standing water as non-potable. Proceeded without intervention.

choices.label: Extract submerged assets
choices.outcome_text: You strip the synthetic fibers from the casualty. The water exposure necessitates immediate decontamination protocols.
choices.epitaph: Extracted assets from submerged casualty. Decontamination protocols required.

choices.label: Dislodge downstream
choices.outcome_text: You push the mass further into the current. The contamination problem is transferred to adjacent sectors.
choices.epitaph: Dislodged aqueous contaminant downstream. Transferred biohazard.

quests.trigger: You locate partially incinerated remains.
quests.discovery: Calcified bone fragments in a shallow burn pit. The thermal execution was aborted prematurely due to insufficient fuel.

choices.label: Disperse ash
choices.outcome_text: You manually crush the remaining calcifications and disperse them into the wind current, completing the disposal protocol.
choices.epitaph: Dispersed incomplete cremation ash. Disposal protocol concluded.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: The site presents zero biological hazard. You continue your route.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed incomplete cremation. Confirmed zero biological hazard.

choices.label: Extract heat-resistant assets
choices.outcome_text: You locate a deformed tungsten ring in the ash. It retains minor scrap value.
choices.epitaph: Extracted deformed tungsten from ash. Scrap value confirmed.

choices.label: Execute secondary burn
choices.outcome_text: You expend your own fuel to re-ignite the pit. The caloric and material expenditure is inefficient.
choices.epitaph: Executed secondary burn on remains. Operation proved inefficient.

quests.trigger: You discover a bound casualty in a containment cell.
quests.discovery: A casualty remains in a holding cell, hands secured with wire. The ballistic impact patterns on the rear wall indicate a formal execution protocol.

choices.label: Sever wire and inter
choices.outcome_text: You cut the wire bindings and bury the unit outside the perimeter. The containment block is cleared.
choices.epitaph: Severed wire bindings and interred executed prisoner. Perimeter cleared.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: The holding cell is functioning as designed. You leave the unit in situ.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed terminated prisoner. Containment cell maintained.

choices.label: Requisition footwear
choices.outcome_text: The military-grade boots are intact. You remove them from the unit and update your inventory.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned military footwear from terminated prisoner.

choices.label: Realign remains
choices.outcome_text: You lack the calories for burial, but sever the wire bindings and lay the unit in a supine position.
choices.epitaph: Severed wire bindings on terminated prisoner. Realigned remains to supine position.

quests.trigger: You discover a casualty that executed its own exit protocol.
quests.discovery: A body in a sealed room. The mechanism of termination is clear and close at hand. A paper document rests nearby, weighted by a stone.

choices.label: Execute burial with document
choices.outcome_text: You inter the unit and the unread document. Their operational logic, whatever it was, is concluded.
choices.epitaph: Interred self-terminated unit with documentation. Operational logic concluded.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You leave the room sealed. The termination requires no further processing.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed self-terminated unit. Termination required no processing.

choices.label: Log as failure
choices.outcome_text: You formally record the unit as a failure of resilience metrics. The data is available to nearby observers.
choices.epitaph: Logged unit as resilience failure. Data observed by local assets.

choices.label: Requisition staging kit
choices.outcome_text: The termination was well-supplied. You strip the kit for your own ongoing operations.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned staging kit from terminated unit. Supplies integrated into ongoing operations.

quests.trigger: You enter a zone of total asset liquidation.
quests.discovery: Dozens of casualties distributed across a sector. The posture of the remains indicates rapid, coordinated liquidation by an organized force.

choices.label: Execute mass burial
choices.outcome_text: You expend two full daylight cycles digging. The caloric cost is severe, but the biological hazard is entirely neutralized.
choices.epitaph: Executed mass burial over two cycles. Neutralized sector biohazard.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You route around the primary hazard zones and leave the liquidation site as found.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed liquidation zone. Maintained route integrity.

choices.label: Execute systematic extraction
choices.outcome_text: You strip the sector of all remaining material assets. The yield is high, though decontamination will be extensive.
choices.epitaph: Executed systematic extraction of liquidation zone. High material yield acquired.

choices.label: Execute thermal sterilization
choices.outcome_text: You ignite the sector. The smoke column is highly visible and draws immediate reconnaissance from neighboring factions.
choices.epitaph: Executed thermal sterilization of liquidation zone. Drew faction reconnaissance.

quests.trigger: An unverified asset requests proximity to your heat source.
quests.discovery: An unknown unit stops at the perimeter of your thermal radius. They display empty hands. 'Thermal sharing requested,' they state.

choices.label: Authorize proximity
choices.outcome_text: You permit entry. They transfer a portion of their caloric reserves and provide updated topographical data for the northern route.
choices.epitaph: Authorized thermal proximity. Acquired updated topographical data.

choices.label: Authorize at maximum range
choices.outcome_text: You assign them the furthest functional radius. Both units maintain readiness. No data is exchanged.
choices.epitaph: Authorized maximum-range thermal proximity. Maintained combat readiness.

choices.label: Deny proximity
choices.outcome_text: You refuse entry. The unit departs, returning to suboptimal thermal conditions.
choices.epitaph: Denied thermal proximity. Contact returned to suboptimal conditions.

choices.label: Execute preemptive strike
choices.outcome_text: You engage immediately. The unit displays higher-than-expected combat readiness despite thermal degradation.
choices.epitaph: Executed preemptive strike on unverified contact. Contact demonstrated high readiness.

quests.trigger: An unknown asset requests medical intervention on a clear route.
quests.discovery: A unit lies immobile in the transit path, actively losing fluid. They signal for assistance. The total lack of cover suggests a potential ambush vector.

choices.label: Provide comprehensive aid
choices.outcome_text: You expend medical supplies and carry their mass. They integrate into your operation and provide ongoing tactical analysis.
choices.epitaph: Provided comprehensive aid to compromised unknown. Unit integrated into operations.

choices.label: Provide basic triage
choices.outcome_text: You apply standard coagulation protocols and direct them to the nearest known medical facility.
choices.epitaph: Provided basic triage. Directed unit to medical facility.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You maintain a wide perimeter and proceed. The signaling ceases shortly after.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed compromised unknown. Signaling ceased.

choices.label: Extract immediate assets
choices.outcome_text: You detach their supply pack and proceed. The ambush, if one existed, does not trigger.
choices.epitaph: Extracted assets from compromised unknown. Evaded potential ambush vector.

quests.trigger: An independent logistics asset offers material exchange.
quests.discovery: A scavenger operating a manual transport cart signals a halt. 'Exchange rates are favorable today,' they state, keeping one hand on their sidearm.

choices.label: Execute standard exchange
choices.outcome_text: You meet the stated caloric price without friction. The asset provides the coordinates of a stable trading hub as a bonus.
choices.epitaph: Executed standard exchange. Acquired coordinates for stable logistics hub.

choices.label: Negotiate deficit
choices.outcome_text: You aggressively contest the valuation. The asset yields slightly to expedite the transaction.
choices.epitaph: Negotiated material deficit. Secured minor caloric advantage.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You signal refusal. The transport cart resumes its operational route.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed mobile logistics node. Conserved material.

choices.label: Requisition inventory
choices.outcome_text: You initiate hostiles and seize the cart. The asset's distress signals are ignored by the sector.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned logistics inventory via force. Sector ignored distress signals.

quests.trigger: You encounter a pre-adolescent asset separated from its unit.
quests.discovery: A small juvenile occupies a structural ruin, emitting low-volume distress vocalizations. 'My primary attachment figure is absent,' they report.

choices.label: Reunite with unit
choices.outcome_text: You expend significant operational time locating their camp. The family unit registers a permanent positive standing for your faction.
choices.epitaph: Reunited juvenile with primary unit. Secured positive faction standing.

choices.label: Transfer to local authority
choices.outcome_text: You deliver the asset to a functioning settlement's intake officer. The officer logs your ID.
choices.epitaph: Transferred unattached juvenile to settlement intake. Identification logged.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You lack the caloric overhead to manage dependents. You proceed. The vocalizations fade with distance.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed unattached juvenile. Conserved caloric overhead.

choices.label: Re-allocate asset
choices.outcome_text: You transfer the juvenile to an unsanctioned labor camp. The asset comprehends the destination prior to arrival.
choices.epitaph: Re-allocated juvenile to labor camp. Subject comprehended destination.

quests.trigger: An AWOL combatant requests concealment from their unit.
quests.discovery: A combatant lacking standard insignia emerges from cover, raising empty hands. 'I abandoned my post. Do not broadcast my coordinates,' they request.

choices.label: Maintain concealment
choices.outcome_text: You omit their presence from your logs. In exchange, the combatant provides advanced weapon maintenance training.
choices.epitaph: Maintained concealment for AWOL combatant. Acquired weapon maintenance data.

choices.label: Process tactical data
choices.outcome_text: You extract their unit's patrol routes and deployment status before allowing them to pass.
choices.epitaph: Processed tactical data from AWOL combatant prior to release.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: Their factional disputes are outside your parameters. You proceed without engagement.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed AWOL combatant. Ignored factional dispute.

choices.label: Broadcast coordinates
choices.outcome_text: You flag their location for the pursuing patrol. You receive a standard ration chit as compensation.
choices.epitaph: Broadcasted AWOL combatant coordinates. Received standard ration chit.

quests.trigger: A high-awareness asset offers classified intelligence.
quests.discovery: A survivor maintains a secure perimeter over a sealed courier bag. 'My threat assessment categorizes you as stable,' they state. 'I hold actionable intelligence.'

choices.label: Process intelligence
choices.outcome_text: The data details hostile rotation schedules for the eastern sector. The broker integrates into your logistics network.
choices.epitaph: Processed actionable intelligence. Integrated broker into logistics network.

choices.label: Verify data integrity
choices.outcome_text: You cross-reference the intelligence before acting. The verified portions prove highly valuable.
choices.epitaph: Verified data integrity. Extracted value from confirmed intelligence.

choices.label: Decline transaction
choices.outcome_text: You refuse the operational risk. The broker seals their courier bag and departs.
choices.epitaph: Declined intelligence transaction. Avoided operational risk.

choices.label: Execute forced extraction
choices.outcome_text: You attempt to secure the bag by force. The broker evades, and your ID is flagged on regional hostile lists.
choices.epitaph: Attempted forced extraction of intelligence. Identification flagged regionally.

quests.trigger: An aged combatant performs weapon maintenance and offers data.
quests.discovery: An older unit in degraded military textiles strips a pre-exchange rifle with mechanical precision. 'Your operational posture is flawed,' they state without looking up.

choices.label: Integrate tactical data
choices.outcome_text: You drill urban clearing tactics until nightfall. Their mechanical memory is flawless. They join your movement the next day.
choices.epitaph: Integrated pre-war clearing tactics. Acquired veteran combatant asset.

choices.label: Extract summary data
choices.outcome_text: You accept a rapid briefing on sight alignment and proceed. The combatant correctly assesses you as a short-term asset.
choices.epitaph: Extracted summary tactical briefing. Combatant retained operational independence.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: Your current posture has ensured survival thus far. You decline the overhead of re-training.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed pre-war combatant. Relied on existing operational posture.

choices.label: Challenge competency
choices.outcome_text: You dismiss their methods as obsolete. Their resulting physical demonstration proves otherwise.
choices.epitaph: Challenged veteran competency. Sustained physical correction.

quests.trigger: A high-stress asset seeks immediate concealment from pursuers.
quests.discovery: An unarmed juvenile breaches your perimeter. 'Tracker units are approaching. I am a designated labor asset. Conceal me,' they demand.

choices.label: Execute concealment
choices.outcome_text: You divert the pursuers with false telemetry. The asset departs before dawn, leaving a high-caloric ration on your pack.
choices.epitaph: Executed concealment for pursued asset. Acquired high-caloric ration.

choices.label: Authorize minimal cover
choices.outcome_text: You allow them to utilize your blind spot but deny active misdirection. The pursuers eventually bypass the sector.
choices.epitaph: Authorized passive cover for pursued asset. Sector bypassed by trackers.

choices.label: Deny entry
choices.outcome_text: You refuse to assume their operational debt. They flee into the adjacent ruin. The trackers follow shortly after.
choices.epitaph: Denied entry to pursued asset. Trackers proceeded through sector.

choices.label: Execute apprehension
choices.outcome_text: You detain the asset and transfer custody to the pursuers. The faction logs a bounty credit to your ID.
choices.epitaph: Executed apprehension of pursued asset. Bounty credit logged.

quests.trigger: A non-verbal unit signals an unknown intent.
quests.discovery: A unit tracking parallel to your route maintains visual contact but refuses vocalization. They perform a complex series of hand signals.

choices.label: Mirror signals and observe
choices.outcome_text: You return neutral gestures. They establish a forward scouting position and clear three ambush points over the next transit cycle.
choices.epitaph: Mirrored non-verbal asset signals. Acquired forward scouting capability.

choices.label: Maintain passive observation
choices.outcome_text: You monitor their vector without engagement. They eventually break contact at a major intersection.
choices.epitaph: Maintained passive observation of non-verbal asset. Contact broken cleanly.

choices.label: Bypass aggressively
choices.outcome_text: You increase pace and alter route to lose them. Unknown variables are unacceptable risks.
choices.epitaph: Aggressively bypassed non-verbal asset. Route security maintained.

choices.label: Initiate hostiles
choices.outcome_text: You designate their tracking as hostile intent. They evade your initial volley with extreme efficiency and vanish.
choices.epitaph: Initiated hostiles on non-verbal asset. Target evaded successfully.

quests.trigger: You detect a rhythmic mechanical distress signal.
quests.discovery: Metallic impacts echo from a sealed subterranean vent. The rhythm is mathematical: three strikes, pause, three strikes. It is not environmental.

choices.label: Execute extraction
choices.outcome_text: You expend heavy labor to pry the grate. The trapped asset shares half their subterranean salvage yield in compensation.
choices.epitaph: Executed heavy extraction on subterranean asset. Acquired salvage yield.

choices.label: Confirm presence
choices.outcome_text: You signal back to confirm their coordinates, then mark the location for better-equipped logistics units.
choices.epitaph: Confirmed subterranean presence. Marked coordinates for extraction teams.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You lack the leverage tools. The acoustic pattern fades as you clear the grid.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed subterranean distress signal. Lacked leverage tools.

choices.label: Exploit extraction zone
choices.outcome_text: You establish a sniper blind to ambush whatever rescue team responds to the noise. Your yield is substantial.
choices.epitaph: Exploited extraction zone for ambush. Salvage yield substantial.

quests.trigger: An unknown unit requests temporary acquisition of your primary tool.
quests.discovery: A scavenger requests your prybar. 'A cache is accessible. My unit requires leverage. The statistical return is high,' they state, maintaining eye contact.

choices.label: Authorize transfer
choices.outcome_text: The tool is returned within 48 hours, upgraded with synthetic grips. They also provide coordinates to a secondary, smaller cache.
choices.epitaph: Authorized temporary tool transfer. Tool upgraded. Secondary cache acquired.

choices.label: Transfer secondary tool
choices.outcome_text: You hand over a degraded spare. The unit logs the lack of trust but executes their operation.
choices.epitaph: Transferred secondary degraded tool. Operation executed.

choices.label: Deny request
choices.outcome_text: Your equipment remains on your person. The unit logs the denial and seeks other options.
choices.epitaph: Denied tool transfer request. Equipment security maintained.

choices.label: Track and exploit
choices.outcome_text: You lend the tool, track their vector, and appropriate the entire cache via force. The tool is recovered.
choices.epitaph: Tracked tool transfer. Exploited cache via force. Tool recovered.

quests.trigger: A failing unit attempts a data handoff.
quests.discovery: A unit approaches your perimeter and collapses. They present a sealed polymer envelope. 'Deliver to the Northern Node. Do not break the seal,' they command, before expiring.

choices.label: Execute delivery protocol
choices.outcome_text: You carry the envelope through hostile sectors. The Northern Node processes the intact seal and grants you permanent high-priority access.
choices.epitaph: Executed delivery protocol. Seal intact. Granted high-priority node access.

choices.label: Break seal and deliver
choices.outcome_text: You analyze the data before delivery. The receiving node detects the breach and processes the intel with zero reward.
choices.epitaph: Breached courier seal. Delivered compromised intel. Zero reward acquired.

choices.label: Log as inventory
choices.outcome_text: You pack the envelope. It remains unopened, occupying mass in your inventory without providing utility.
choices.epitaph: Logged courier envelope as inventory. Utility remains zero.

choices.label: Liquidate data
choices.outcome_text: You sell the encrypted envelope to a local data broker. The payout covers three days of rations.
choices.epitaph: Liquidated courier data. Acquired three days caloric rations.

quests.trigger: A micro-asset conducts inefficient salvage operations.
quests.discovery: A pre-adolescent asset with severe caloric deficit is attempting to extract metals from a collapsed concrete slab. Their mechanical efficiency is near zero.

choices.label: Execute joint extraction
choices.outcome_text: You provide caloric support and apply leverage to the slab. The extracted metals are divided. The juvenile transfers a non-functional gear as 'luck.'
choices.epitaph: Executed joint extraction with juvenile forager. Extracted metals divided.

choices.label: Transfer minimal calories
choices.outcome_text: You transfer a low-value ration. The juvenile consumes it without ceasing their inefficient extraction attempt.
choices.epitaph: Transferred minimal calories to juvenile forager. Inefficient extraction continued.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You inform them the structure is unstable. They ignore the data. You proceed.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed juvenile forager. Unstable structure warning ignored.

choices.label: Requisition extracted assets
choices.outcome_text: You appropriate the minor scrap they have already uncovered. The asset lacks the mass to contest the seizure.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned extracted assets from juvenile forager. Contest impossible.

quests.trigger: An older unit requests data processing for pre-war texts.
quests.discovery: An elderly unit with severe ocular degradation holds a bundle of pre-exchange paper documents. 'I require audio translation of these civilian texts,' they state.

choices.label: Process complete archive
choices.outcome_text: You read the civilian correspondence aloud. The data is entirely non-tactical. The older unit logs the audio and confirms 'historical accuracy.'
choices.epitaph: Processed complete archive of civilian texts. Confirmed historical accuracy.

choices.label: Process data sample
choices.outcome_text: You translate two documents to confirm their non-tactical nature. The unit accepts the sample and terminates the request.
choices.epitaph: Processed sample of civilian texts. Request terminated.

choices.label: Deny processing request
choices.outcome_text: You refuse to expend operational time on non-actionable data. The unit secures the documents.
choices.epitaph: Denied processing request for non-actionable data.

choices.label: Requisition paper assets
choices.outcome_text: You seize the documents for use as combustion fuel. The elderly unit cannot mount a defense.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned archival documents for combustion fuel.

quests.trigger: An unverified unit requests thermal sheltering during an extreme weather event.
quests.discovery: A severe pressure drop is imminent. An unknown asset arrives at your perimeter. 'Requesting temporary structural cover. No aggressive intent,' they state.

choices.label: Authorize structural entry
choices.outcome_text: You permit entry. The unit powers down in a corner. At dawn, they have departed, leaving a bundle of dry combustion fuel as payment.
choices.epitaph: Authorized structural entry for refugee. Acquired combustion fuel payment.

choices.label: Authorize perimeter cover
choices.outcome_text: You allow them to utilize the exterior structural overhang. They survive the thermal drop and depart at first light.
choices.epitaph: Authorized perimeter cover for refugee. Thermal drop survived.

choices.label: Deny cover
choices.outcome_text: You secure your perimeter. The unit is forced back into the hazard zone. The probability of their survival is statistically low.
choices.epitaph: Denied cover to environmental refugee. Survival probability low.

choices.label: Execute perimeter defense
choices.outcome_text: You present lethal force to ensure they do not compromise your structure. They retreat into the lethal weather.
choices.epitaph: Executed perimeter defense. Forced refugee into lethal weather.

quests.trigger: You locate the remains of a surveyor with intact cartographic data.
quests.discovery: A unit rests against a wall, expired from dehydration. A logbook sits open. 'Grid 47 invalid. Fluid zero. Transmit data to dependent unit,' the final entry reads.

choices.label: Extract data and inter
choices.outcome_text: You bury the unit and secure the logbook. The invalid grid data is logged. You will attempt transmission if the dependent unit is located.
choices.epitaph: Extracted cartographic data and interred surveyor. Dependent unit pending.

choices.label: Acknowledge and proceed
choices.outcome_text: You confirm the invalidity of Grid 47 for your own routing and leave the remains in situ.
choices.epitaph: Acknowledged invalid grid data. Left surveyor remains in situ.

choices.label: Extract cartography only
choices.outcome_text: You strip the map section of the logbook and leave the personal data behind. The map is flawed, but provides baseline geography.
choices.epitaph: Extracted baseline cartography. Discarded personal surveyor data.

choices.label: Execute full requisition
choices.outcome_text: You strip the unit of all functional gear, including footwear and textiles. The biological frame is left to the elements.
choices.epitaph: Executed full requisition of surveyor assets. Biological frame discarded.

quests.trigger: A scavenger with a severe structural injury refuses to relocate.
quests.discovery: A unit sits in a debris field, applying pressure to a severe laceration. 'Do not engage. Operational capability is zero. Awaiting termination,' they state.

choices.label: Execute medical intervention
choices.outcome_text: You expend medical supplies to stabilize the laceration. The unit processes the intervention and provides actionable safe-routing data for the adjacent block.
choices.epitaph: Executed medical intervention on degraded forager. Acquired safe-routing data.

choices.label: Transfer medical supplies
choices.outcome_text: You throw a sterilized bandage pack to their coordinates. They initiate self-repair protocols.
choices.epitaph: Transferred medical supplies to degraded forager. Self-repair initiated.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You obey the directive and do not engage. Their termination is highly probable.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed degraded forager per directive. Termination probable.

choices.label: Requisition inventory
choices.outcome_text: You strip their supply pack. They lack the structural integrity to mount a defense and observe the requisition silently.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned inventory from degraded forager. Defense capability zero.
